title: Winds, Storms and Cyclones
summary: Air moves from high to low pressure. Uneven heating drives sea breezes and monsoons; warm oceans power cyclones.

ib.note: Links to MYP Individuals & Societies (weather and climate)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 6: Pressure, Winds, Storms and Cyclones

objectives: I can explain that wind is air moving from high pressure to low pressure.
I can explain sea breezes, land breezes and the monsoon using uneven heating.
I can describe how a cyclone forms and evaluate ways to reduce cyclone damage.
misconceptions: Wind blows from low to high pressure.
Hot air ‘sucks’ in cold air (the cooler air is pushed in by higher pressure).
